articles.summary: Sarah Rose, vice president of global services at Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, will be honored by the Information Display & Entertainment Association (IDEA) at the 2026 IDEA Conference in Cincinnati, Ohio. Rose, along with John Adams of The Score, are two long-time fixtures in the sports industry who will be inducted into the IDEA Hall of Fame at a formal ceremony on July 15 during the conference.
articles.title: IDEA to Induct Sarah Rose Into Hall of Fame
